test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following maintenance practices helps prevent overheating in a DC motor?
solution:
__**Concept**__

In a DC motor, the bearings support the rotating shaft, allowing the armature to rotate smoothly. If the bearings are not properly lubricated:

 
• Friction between moving parts increases
 
• Mechanical losses increase
 
• Extra friction converts mechanical energy into heat
 
• This heat spreads to the shaft, armature, and housing, causing overheating

Overheating in a DC motor is commonly caused by excessive friction, especially in the bearings. **Regular lubrication of bearings reduces friction and mechanical losses, which directly helps in preventing overheating.**
